components.name: Announcement
components.summary: Announcement is a short teacher post shown to every student in a class, newest first.

components.name: Badge
components.summary: Badge is a small uppercase pill that labels a role, a class or a status.

components.name: Button
components.summary: Button is the single control for every action, in four styles and two sizes.

components.name: CourseCard
components.summary: CourseCard is the tappable card a student uses to open an assigned course, with its class, due date and progress.

components.name: JoinCode
components.summary: JoinCode shows a class's five-character join code in a tinted bar with Copy and New code actions.

components.name: QuizOption
components.summary: QuizOption is one answer choice in a module's quick check; it shows the result after the student answers.

components.name: StudentRow
components.summary: StudentRow is one line of the teacher's roster: avatar and name, a progress bar, modules done and the quiz score.
